newsitem.title: USA: McCrory to liquidate assets at 300 stores.
newsitem.headline: McCrory to liquidate assets at 300 stores.

text.p: Bankrupt retailer McCrory Corp. said Wednesday it agreed to liquidate all its inventory of furniture, fixtures and equipment at 300 stores.
It said the liquidation sale should generate between $45 million and $50 million, which will be used to reduce its borrowings under a credit agreement with CIT Group/Business Credit Inc.

On Jan. 8, McCrory said it had defaulted on the credit agreement by failing to satisfy a so-called "clean-up" provision, which required that its outstanding debt, excluding letters of credit, not exceed $30 million on Dec. 31.
The company's total debt exceeded $52 million, McCrory said.
A hearing on the liquidation agreement is scheduled for Jan. 23 in U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the Southern District of New York, McCrory said.
